Pampered Chef is seeking a Junior Infrastructure Engineer to support and evolve its hybrid infrastructure across on-premises, Microsoft Azure, and Amazon Web Services environments. The role focuses on infrastructure administration, cloud security, virtualization, monitoring, backup and recovery, automation, incident response, and operational documentation.
Consulting
Marketing
Cooking
Direct Marketing
Direct Sales
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Maintain and support Windows and Linux server environments, ensuring availability, performance, and security across both on-premises and cloud-hosted workloads
Upgrade and maintain core infrastructure services, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP
Implement regular software updates, patches, and security updates to optimize performance and mitigate vulnerabilities
Troubleshoot server, operating system, and infrastructure-related issues to ensure reliable service delivery
Deploy, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain cloud infrastructure hosted within AWS and Microsoft Azure environments
Support AWS services including EC2, VPC, IAM, Route 53, S3, CloudWatch, and backup and recovery services
Assist in the design, implementation, and support of secure cloud architectures following company security standards and industry best practices
Monitor cloud infrastructure for availability, performance, capacity, cost optimization, and security risks
Support cloud security controls, including identity and access management, role-based access controls, encryption, logging, monitoring, vulnerability remediation, and infrastructure hardening
Support cloud and infrastructure disaster recovery, resilience, and business continuity initiatives, including participation in recovery testing activities
Administer and maintain Microsoft Hyper-V and VMware virtualization environments, supporting VM provisioning, lifecycle management, and resource optimization
Participate as an active member of the SecOps team, contributing to virtual infrastructure management with an emphasis on Infrastructure-as-Code principles
Assist with capacity planning and performance optimization of virtualized environments
Administer and support Microsoft 365 and Azure environments, including Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Teams
Maintain and support the broader Microsoft cloud ecosystem, including Entra ID, Microsoft Defender, Exchange, and Intune
Manage identity, access, and authentication services including MFA, Conditional Access, role-based access control (RBAC), and identity lifecycle management
Support implementation and maintenance of security policies and compliance controls across Microsoft cloud services
Proactively monitor infrastructure components with a focus on availability, performance, security, and optimization; respond to alerts and escalate as appropriate
Administer and validate system backup operations leveraging Rubrik, ensuring recoverability and compliance with data protection standards
Troubleshoot complex technical issues and perform root cause analysis to prevent recurrence
Participate in infrastructure and security incident response activities, assisting with investigation, containment, remediation, and documentation
Support disaster recovery validation exercises and ensure infrastructure recovery procedures remain current and effective
Develop and maintain automation, configuration, provisioning, and monitoring solutions to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort
Automate infrastructure build, deployment, and management tasks using PowerShell, AI-assisted automation tools, cloud-native automation services, and Infrastructure-as-Code technologies
Create and maintain repeatable infrastructure deployment standards and operational procedures
Develop and maintain infrastructure runbooks, recovery procedures, process flows, architecture diagrams, and technical documentation
Support standardization, security hardening, compliance initiatives, and operational maturity improvements through automation and documentation
Communicate professionally and effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization regarding technical issues, project status, infrastructure changes, and operational risks
Collaborate closely with Infrastructure, Security Operations, Service Desk, Networking, and Application teams to resolve issues and improve service reliability
Maintain a working knowledge of networking fundamentals, cloud technologies, security principles, and infrastructure appliances to support cross-functional troubleshooting and collaboration
Participate in after-hours maintenance activities and on-call rotations as needed

Windows Server Administration
Linux Server Administration

Required
Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field; equivalent experience considered
1-3 years of hands-on experience in systems administration, infrastructure support, cloud operations, or related IT roles
Demonstrated experience with Windows Server/ Linux, and Virtualization administration
Experience supporting enterprise infrastructure in both on-premises and cloud environments
Working knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP administration
Foundational experience with Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 services including Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and Intune
Foundational knowledge of AWS cloud services including EC2, IAM, VPC, Route 53, S3, CloudWatch, and security best practices
Basic understanding of networking concepts including VLANs, TCP/IP, routing, firewalls, VPNs, and load balancing
Experience using PowerShell or similar scripting languages for administrative automation
Knowledge of infrastructure security fundamentals, vulnerability management, patch management, and system hardening concepts
Understanding of backup, recovery, and disaster recovery principles
Preferred
Familiarity with virtualization platforms, preferably Microsoft Hyper-V and/or VMware vSphere
AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, AWS Solutions Architect - Associate, or equivalent AWS certification
Experience with Rubrik or a comparable enterprise backup and recovery platform
Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code technologies such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, or PowerShell
Experience leveraging AI-assisted tools to improve infrastructure administration, monitoring, automation, or operational efficiency
Familiarity with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud, or similar enterprise security platforms
Experience supporting disaster recovery testing and business continuity initiatives
Basic understanding of Linux server administration, including RHEL, Ubuntu, or CentOS
